task_anchors.task_description: Retaining and lightly adjusting a handed-off numeric completion-time estimate after new car-count and cycle-speed information became available.
Interpreting a borderline hot-box sensor alert and deciding to pull an entire eleven-car cut rather than the single flagged car.
Integrating two conflicting independent carman inspection reports and a historical repair entry, then requesting a third inspection.
Deciding to set out the unresolved car and dispatch the remainder of the train under a closing SLA deadline, after confirming penalty terms with the dispatcher.
